action.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import chess, re
# FEN from position.pgn
pgn=open('/app/position.pgn').read()
fen_pgn=re.search(r'\[FEN "([^"]+)"\]',pgn).group(1)
example_fen='6k1/5ppp/8/8/8/8/5PPP/4R1K1 w - - 0 1'
print('pgn FEN   :', fen_pgn)
print('example   :', example_fen)
print('IDENTICAL :', fen_pgn==example_fen)
b=chess.Board(fen_pgn)
mates=[b.san(m) for m in b.legal_moves if (lambda mm: (b.push(mm) or b.is_checkmate()) and not b.pop())(m)]
# simpler mate detection
mates=[]
for m in b.legal_moves:
    b.push(m)
    if b.is_checkmate(): mates.append(b.san(m) if False else True)
    b.pop()
# recompute san list
moves=list(b.legal_moves)
res=[]
for m in moves:
    san=b.san(m)
    b.push(m)
    if b.is_checkmate(): res.append(san)
    b.pop()
print('ALL mating moves:', res)
EOF
action.explanation: Verify the PGN FEN is byte-identical to the example FEN whose answer is leaked, and enumerate all mating moves
